purpose: Parameter counts for SLU comparators. Neither AGIF (arXiv 2004.10087) nor GL-GIN (arXiv 2106.01925) reports a total; these are analytic estimates from the official default configs.
uncertainty: approximate (+/- ~30%): decoder/GAT/attention internals were approximated, not instantiated; third-party code was not executed
comparison: ARN-v2 (BERT-Tiny) is 4.48M params on these tasks, i.e. ~5-7x LARGER than AGIF/GL-GIN; the SLU benchmarks are therefore a generality check, not a size-efficiency claim
